items.html: And behold, then ZON clothe AA in this manner, and it is that they clothe the lower third of the Tifferet and the NHY of Arich, which are four Sefirot. And behold, the Malchut, the Nukva of ZA, takes the lower joint of the Hod of Arich, and then it was called "a step outward," which is the point and the lower tip of the small Vav within the Hey of Bina. And although it took only the lower third of the Hod, the whole Hod is called by its name, since it is not entirely for ZA.
